P01.rationale: The founder portrait is present but small and secondary to the large '03' numeral; it lacks dominance as a primary anchor.

P05.rationale: The client portrait is framed and named but appears tiny relative to the column width, failing to meet the meaningful size requirement.

P07.rationale: No social-proof apparatus (press logos, rating cards, review grid) is visible; only a single testimonial quote exists without structural support.

P10.rationale: The oversized '03' numeral functions as a giant ghost glyph that dominates the right column and anchors the layout compositionally.

P11.rationale: Data visualizations are present (before/after text comparison), but they lack graphical charts or cost-math elements; they are typographic rather than illustrative.

P12.rationale: The page reads as a dense, magazine-quality editorial layout with tight spacing and full utilization of both columns without sparse gaps.

P13.rationale: A subtle paper texture is present in the background, but it is minimal and does not create a strong atmospheric presence compared to flat alternatives.

P14.rationale: No full-bleed photo is used; therefore, no treatment for overlaid text readability applies here.

P16.rationale: No device or product mockup (phone/laptop/book) is shown anywhere on the page to add credibility.

N07.rationale: The client portrait appears specific and authentic rather than generic stock imagery, though it lacks contextual business environment details.

N08.rationale: Dead whitespace is minimal; the layout fills most of the sheet with content, though some vertical rhythm gaps exist between sections.

N10.rationale: Text sits cleanly on solid backgrounds without busy photo overlays or awkward inset gaps; no readability issues observed.
